# Armor of Resistance (`magic-items:armor-of-resistance`)
**Category:** [Armor](../equipment-categories/armor.md) | **Rarity:** Rare | **Attunement:** Yes

Armor (Any Light, Medium, or Heavy)

You have Resistance to one type of damage while you wear this armor. The GM chooses the type or determines it randomly by rolling on the following table.

| 1d10 | Damage Type |
|---|---|
| 1 | Acid |
| 2 | Cold |
| 3 | Fire |
| 4 | Force |
| 5 | Lightning |
| 6 | Necrotic |
| 7 | Poison |
| 8 | Psychic |
| 9 | Radiant |
| 10 | Thunder |
